name: kayrah87/dummyjson-user-connector
description: A framework-agnostic PHP 8.4 connector for the DummyJSON users API.

suggest.psr/http-client-implementation: A PSR-18 HTTP client is required at runtime. Any of: guzzlehttp/guzzle, symfony/http-client, or php-http/guzzle7-adapter.
suggest.psr/http-factory-implementation: A PSR-17 factory implementation is required at runtime. Any of: nyholm/psr7, guzzlehttp/psr7, or http-interop/http-factory-guzzle.

scripts-descriptions.test: Run the hermetic unit test suite.
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Run the integration test suite (hits the live DummyJSON API).
scripts-descriptions.test:coverage: Run unit tests with coverage (clover XML at build/logs/clover.xml).
scripts-descriptions.check-coverage: Enforce the 90% line-coverage threshold against the clover report.
scripts-descriptions.lint: Check code style without modifying files (php-cs-fixer dry-run).
scripts-descriptions.ci: Full CI pipeline: lint, stan, coverage, threshold check.
